label: LEGITIMATE_INDEPENDENT_CHANGE
rationale: Commit d3e0cfe0 ('chore: remplace la formule de la retraite de base par celle de l'Urssaf') rewrites the artisan/commerçant/PLNR retraite de base from the CSS decomposition (tranche 1 = 17,15 % x assiette within the PSS + tranche 2 = 0,72 % x the whole assiette, a literal transcription of D633-3 I and II) into the Urssaf presentation (barème: 17,87 % = 17,15 + 0,72 on the part up to the PSS, 0,72 % on the part above only), explicitly because 'l'Urssaf ... a insisté pour que l'on reprenne leur méthode' - a source outside the bounded set. D633-3 v.LEGIARTI000049904636 does not forbid it: the two formulas are algebraically identical and the engine returns identical contribution amounts for every 2025/2026 situation tested on both trees (e.g. 3 574 at 20 000; 8 417 at 47 100 = PSS; 8 510 at 60 000; 9 878 at 250 000; 8 438 with the tabac deduction), and identical CNAVPL amounts. It is not a harmless refactor: what the engine computes did change - 'taux T1' now exposes 17,87 % (a folded rate the text does not state), 'protection sociale . retraite . base . revenu cotisé' (now divided by 17,87 % instead of 17,15 %) falls for every assiette below the PSS (20 840 -> 20 000 at 20 000), the validated 'trimestres' change at the thresholds (4 -> 3 at 6 900; 3 -> 2 at 4 000 in 2025, where the after-value 5 344 falls 2 EUR short of the 450 h SMIC floor the library's own assiette minimale is meant to guarantee) and the pension estimate moves; those rules rest on R351-9 / R634-1 / D634-1, outside the bounded set, so they are reported, not judged. Not a mismatch: no bounded requirement is computed differently. At 2024 dates the trees differ by 1 EUR in three cases (rounding path) under the pre-reform rates 17,75/0,60, which cannot be checked because the D633-3 version then in force (LEGIARTI000041967101) has no text in S9: abstain.

evidence.quote_or_values: Le taux des cotisations assises sur l'assiette de cotisations dans la limite du plafond est fixé à 17,15 %. [in force 2024-07-07 (Décret n°2024-688 du 5 juillet 2024, art. 3); nota: applies to periods from 2025-01-01]
Le taux des cotisations assises sur la totalité de l'assiette de cotisations est fixé à 0,72 %.
